hello.description: prints a line a second for N seconds, then a JSON summary, and exits with the code you ask for
command:
import json, sys
a = sys.argv[1:]
get = lambda k, d: a[a.index(k) + 1] if k in a else d
name, n, code = get('--name', 'world'), int(get('--seconds', '5')), int(get('--exit', '0'))
print('hello, ' + name, flush=True)
import time
for i in range(n):
    print('tick', i + 1, 'of', n, flush=True)
    time.sleep(1)
print(json.dumps({'hello': name, 'seconds': n, 'exit': code}), flush=True)
sys.exit(code)
